references.text: In your descendants all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you have listened to my voice.
I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and give them all these lands. In your offspring all the nations of the earth shall be blessed.

Your descendants shall be like the dust of the earth, and you shall spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south. In you and in your offspring all the families of the earth shall be blessed.
from east and west, from north and south.
Do not fear, for I am with you! From the east I will bring your offspring, and from the west I will gather you.
Behold, these shall come from afar, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.

Remember therefore that you, who were once Gentiles by birth and called uncircumcised by those who call themselves circumcised (which is done in the flesh with hands), were at that time without Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel and strangers to the covenants of promise, having no hope and without God in the world. But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off have been brought near by the blood of Christ.
For it is also written: Behold, I am laying in Zion a cornerstone, chosen and precious. The one who believes in him will not be put to shame.

After this I looked, and behold, a great multitude that no one could number, from every nation, from all tribes and peoples and languages. They stood before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.
